purpose: Enforce the complete Occurrence-generation aggregate contract: source/governing-state truth, current-at-materialization rule membership, exact family coordinate, range, duplicate and quota semantics.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Validates generated Occurrence provenance against the exact governing recurrence material state.
state_history.current_binding: New recurrence-generated Occurrences require the governing recurrence state to be current at materialization time; historical rows retain their old governing state afterward.
state_history.chronology: Validation uses stored deterministic coordinates, never insertion/UUID/current-time ordering.
state_history.immutability_policy: Deferred bounded validator only; no orchestration or external side effects.

obligations: M6 Role-13 integrity and routine-security proof
